sections.html:
Holding down the southwest corner of the Salt Lake Valley, West Jordan runs from the Jordan River up toward the Oquirrh range. Its neighbors are Taylorsville and Kearns on the north, South Jordan on the south, and Sandy, Murray and Midvale on the east. The city spans about 31 to 32 square miles and sits a bit above 4,300 feet.

Population rose from 68,336 in 2000 to 103,712 in 2010 and 116,961 in 2020, which ranks third in Utah. The July 2025 estimate shown above is 116,812, so the climb has stopped. The city was incorporated on January 10, 1941. It counted 27,192 people in 1980, and most of the housing was built after that.

Homeowner vacancy was 0.6% and rental vacancy 7.2% in 2020, so few owner-occupied houses sat empty.

Welby, Copper Hills and Jordan Hills climb the Oquirrh foothills in the west. Views and drainage there are nothing like the level streets near the river, and shoppers compare the two areas.

Three things come up most on hillside lots:

  • Foundation cracks, and where rain and snowmelt run.
  • Roof age, since snow and summer sun both wear shingles.
  • How old the furnace and air conditioner are.

How much earthquake risk a house carries depends on nearby hazards and the year it was built, so some buyers ask about foundation age and retrofits. Salt Lake City, the nearest long-term weather station, averages a January high of 38.6 degrees and low of 24.2, and a July high of 94.0 and low of 68.2. It gets about 15.5 inches of precipitation and roughly 52 inches of snow a year, and strong winter inversions trap air in the valley.

I-15 skirts the east edge of the city and I-215 bends to the northeast. Bangerter Highway runs through the middle and Redwood Road through the east. The Mountain View Corridor has ten lanes and exits at 7800 South, 9000 South and Old Bingham Highway; its first phase opened December 15, 2012. TRAX light rail started running August 7, 2011, and six stops are inside West Jordan.

How close a house sits to a rail stop or an on-ramp is something buyers ask about early. Homes along Bangerter Highway or Redwood Road may have traffic noise, and homes a short walk from a station attract commuters.

The Jordan School District serves most of West Jordan, while two small northern pockets belong to Granite School District. West Jordan has 16 elementary schools, four middle schools and two high schools, West Jordan High and Copper Hills High. A house near a district edge can feed a different school than the neighbor across the street, so ask the district to confirm the boundary for your address.

A rental in West Jordan requires a General Business License plus a Rental Dwelling application. Owners may also join the city's voluntary Good Landlord Program: finish a four-hour class, keep a signed agreement, a written lease and rental applications on file, and the fee is discounted. The class has to be retaken every four years.

The city expects at least one free off-street parking space for every rental unit, and it reports that single-family rentals generate 78% more police and fire calls each year than owner-occupied homes. Code enforcement is located at 8000 S. Redwood Road and answers at 801-569-5000. Complaints can be filed through the Report a Problem form on the city website.

If the house is a rental, make sure the license is current before you sell and any open code complaint is cleared, so neither turns up during a buyer's review. A buyer or lender may ask for the license number, the lease and a list of recent repairs, and having them ready shortens the back-and-forth.

sections.h2: Property tax: what you owe and when
sections.html:
Think of the Salt Lake County tax year as a short sequence:

  • January 1: the date your property's value is set.
  • By July 22: valuation notices arrive in the mail.
  • August 1 to September 15: you may appeal to the Board of Equalization.
  • By November 1: tax notices go out.
  • November 30: payment is due. From December 1 an unpaid balance is delinquent.

A home that is your primary residence gets Utah's 45% exemption on up to one acre, so only 55% of market value is taxed. A second home or an empty house is taxed at 100%. Moved out but still the owner? Check which rate your bill uses before you list, since a buyer's lender will see it.

sections.h2: Recording the deed at the county
sections.html:
To file a deed, go to the Salt Lake County Recorder at 2001 South State Street, Suite N1-600. Cost is a flat $40.00 per recording, with $2.00 more for each legal description past the tenth. The paperwork needs the parcel number, the grantee's mailing address and a notary acknowledgment. The counter is open Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

On an ordinary sale the title company takes care of this at closing. If the house passes within a family or through an estate, bring the deed and your latest tax notice so names and the parcel number line up before filing.

A conventional listing means an agent, yard signs, weeks of showings and a closing that waits on the buyer's lender. It tends to suit a sound house and an owner with time. A for-sale-by-owner sale saves the commission but puts pricing, marketing and paperwork on you. A cash offer gives up some price in return for speed and certainty, and it makes the most sense when the house has deferred repairs, a tenant, a late mortgage or an estate attached.

Cash Home Buyers purchases houses across Utah, including West Jordan, in their current condition. We show how an offer is calculated, you take whatever time you need, and the decision is yours. Before you call, collect the deed, your last tax notice, any rental license and any loan statement.

sections.h2: Selling with taxes or tenants in place
sections.html:
An unpaid tax balance will not stop a sale. At closing the title company takes it from your proceeds and splits the current year's bill with the buyer. A tenant is more complicated, because the rental should meet city rules and you should know the lease terms before you speak with buyers. When a tenant, back taxes or needed repairs would drag out a regular listing, a cash sale can be the simpler route.

Start with the deed and the county's latest notice. If a figure looks wrong, call the Recorder or the Treasurer.

faqs.q: What county is West Jordan, UT in?
faqs.a: Salt Lake County. Everything from the tax bill to a valuation appeal to deed recording is handled by county offices in Salt Lake City.

faqs.q: When are property taxes due in West Jordan?
faqs.a: Payment is due by November 30, and a balance still open on December 1 is delinquent. Notices are sent before November 1.

faqs.q: Does West Jordan require a rental license?
faqs.a: Yes. Landlords need a General Business License and a Rental Dwelling application. The Good Landlord Program is voluntary and gives a discounted fee to owners who finish the required class.

faqs.q: Which school district is West Jordan in?
faqs.a: The Jordan School District serves most of West Jordan, while two small northern pockets belong to Granite School District.

faqs.q: Can I sell my West Jordan house without repairs?
faqs.a: Yes. You are not obliged to repair anything first. A cash buyer accepts the house as it stands, and you decide once the offer is in front of you.
